claim_text: The 2026 USTR Special 301 Report characterises China's pharmaceutical trial data conditions as imposing unfair and discriminatory conditions on the effective protection against unfair commercial use, as well as unauthorized disclosure, of undisclosed test or other data generated to obtain marketing approval for pharmaceutical products.

Article 1 of the China-Germany BIT (2003) includes trade and business secrets explicitly alongside know-how, technical processes, and other intellectual property categories in its investment definition.

Hela Schwarz GmbH v. People's Republic of China (ICSID ARB/17/19, Award December 10, 2025) dismissed all claims on jurisdictional grounds for failure to withdraw concurrent Chinese court proceedings before commencing the ICSID arbitration.

UNCITRAL advance copy A/CN.9/1246, the Draft supplementary provisions on the conduct of proceedings to resolve international investment disputes, structures the text into numbered provisions including Provision II Bifurcation, Provision III Interim measures, and Provision IV Manifest lack of legal merit.
supporting_locator: Table of contents, Draft supplementary provisions, A/CN.9/1246 advance copy

claim_text: The UNCITRAL Working Group III procedural-reform work identified early dismissal of frivolous claims, security for costs and counterclaims among the procedural concerns to be addressed.
The UNCITRAL Supplementary Provisions have been prepared to function primarily in an ad hoc setting, with parties able to agree to preferred arbitration rules as complemented by the SPs.
The UNCITRAL supplement would not automatically apply to ISDS proceedings arising under pre-existing investment treaties, allowing States that oppose it to avoid its application.
The UNCITRAL Supplementary Provisions on the Conduct of Proceedings (A/CN.9/1246) and related Advisory Centre documents were submitted to the Commission at its fifty-ninth session in 2026.
supporting_locator: UNCITRAL Rabat workshop page, texts submitted 2026
